instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/p1.step, /home/user/Desktop/p2.step, /home/user/Desktop/p3.step in FreeCAD Path/CAM. Use FreeCAD with the Path/CAM modules. Create three separate FreeCAD Path/CAM Jobs. Each Job origin must be at that part's top-face center. Use T1 to machine the outside Profile of each part down to the bottom with S7000 rpm and F500 mm/min. Tool definition: T1 is an end mill reused for the three outside Profile jobs. Write the required output file(s) to the output folder using exactly these absolute file paths: /home/user/Desktop/p1.nc, /home/user/Desktop/p2.nc, /home/user/Desktop/p3.nc. [Software] To use FreeCAD, run `freecad` from a terminal (use the full executable path if it is not on PATH).
